description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface 'LeaveDao' for managing 'leaves' data in a Room database, including methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting leave records.

classes.name: LeaveDao
classes.description: Interface for accessing leave records in the database using Room and coroutines.

methods.name: getAllLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves all leave records ordered by date in descending order.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves leave records within a specified date range.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leave records modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts a new leave record, replacing on conflict.
